audit.whatIsWrong: EVEN at 6/10 undersells a 59.42% Emerald+ win rate over 69 games.
audit.why: Nearly 60% across a usable sample is a strongly favoured lane, and the page's own chart gives Aurora four of seven stages.
Aurora 2-3 and first item, Mel reclaiming at 2+ items as Overwhelm stacks and Golden Eclipse come online. That matches a stacking-execute scaler against an early-burst mage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rebuttal REFLECTS projectiles back at the attacker. Twofold Hex is a projectile, so poking into her W does not merely whiff — it hits you. The mid breakdown says to bait it but never says what happens if you do not, and the cooldown is never given. It is 38s at rank 1, the longest non-ultimate cooldown in this slice.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Mel forms a barrier around herself that reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker, prevents her from taking damage, and grants her movement speed.' Cooldown 38/35/33/29/26.
audit.corrected: Never open with Twofold Hex into a held Rebuttal — the missile comes back at you. Bait it with a throwaway cast, then you have 38 seconds at rank 1 to run your whole pattern.

audit.whatIsWrong: Golden Eclipse is global — it strikes every enemy carrying Overwhelm regardless of distance. Nothing on the page tells you that walking away, recalling, or leaving the rift does not put you out of range of her ult.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Mel strikes all enemies marked with Overwhelm regardless of their distance from her.' Range is listed as 25000.
audit.corrected: Overwhelm stacks follow you off the map — retreating low with stacks on you is how you die to her, and the answer is to shed the trade before the stacks pile up, not to walk away after.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three places claim Between Worlds makes Aurora 'untargetable to her from outside the rift', so she can walk through Radiant Volley and Solar Snare. Between Worlds grants no untargetability, and Solar Snare is a root that will land.
audit.why: Between Worlds: damage, slow inside the area, and a teleport from one side to the other.
audit.corrected: The rift wins by slowing her inside it and letting you cross the zone — you still have to dodge Solar Snare.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown block calls Solar Snare matchup-defining with no number and omits Rebuttal entirely.
audit.why: Mel Q 10s, W 38s, E 11s, R 120s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Rebuttal 38s at rank 1 is the real window; Solar Snare 11s; Golden Eclipse 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mel is called 'he'/'his' in the TL;DR, dosFull[2].t and breakdown.late.
